title: Match capitals: Southern Asia
intro: Match each country in Southern Asia with its capital city.

pairs.explain: Kabul is the capital of Afghanistan.
Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh.
Thimphu is the capital of Bhutan.
New Delhi is the capital of India.
Tehran is the capital of Iran (Islamic Republic of).
Colombo is the capital of Sri Lanka.
Malé is the capital of Maldives.
Kathmandu is the capital of Nepal.
